t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Colours of knomes relate to how many mushrooms you can collect, however these can swap during the game.Focus and dont have any distrations

vb_textbox.text: Click on one side until you have gone though the colours to determine which are giving the most mushrooms.Be quick I go timed out a couple of times. Some colours give more mushrooms that others.Beware:   It does change throughout the game but I would just repeat chosing one side until you determine the colours and points again.
